test_impact_summary: 当日测试影响集中在两点：DP2+PP2 golden 更新后，需要持续关注该路径输出的确定性，尤其是 prompt 1 的 golden 尚未被实际观测验证；DeepSeek V4 的 ND 格式保持新增了单测覆盖线性层后处理逻辑，但缺少对 compressor 和 DSA 层标志设置的直接测试，建议在单元测试中补充对模型内部层属性的断言，以覆盖这两个自定义执行路径的配置条件。整体上现有 E2E 和单测框架可以支撑，但需要针对新逻辑增加针对性看护。

commits.comment: 该 commit 是一个 CI 测试基线修复。上游 #15299 移除了 MoE top-k routing weights 的中间 dtype 转换，导致 DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat 在 DP2+PP2 路径上的贪婪解码输出发生变化（'I'm a' -> 'I am a'）。变更引入了独立的 DP_GOLDEN 以隔离 DP2+PP2 的基线，避免影响 TP2+PP2 的共享 GOLDEN。实现方式是复制 GOLDEN 并更新 prompt 0 的输出序列，prompt 1 保持共享值。风险较低，但 prompt 1 的 DP2 输出未在失败日志中实际观察到，存在不确定性；且新的 golden 依赖确定性输出，若未来 MoE 路由权重数值再次变化，该测试仍需同步更新。测试文件位于 e2e/four_card，属于 CI 看护范围。

test_impact.reason: 该 commit 本身是 E2E golden 更新，不需要额外新增测试，但 DP2+PP2 路径的 prompt 1 输出尚未实际验证，后续若 CI 报告 drift 需同步更新；且该路径对 MoE routing weight dtype 变化敏感，建议保持 CI 对该用例的持续看护。

commits.message:
[BugFix][CI] Update DeepSeek-V2-Lite DP2+PP2 golden after MoE routing weight dtype change (#15875)

## Issue
`test_models_pp2_dp2[mp/ray-2-2-deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat]` in
`tests/e2e/pull_request/four_card/test_pipeline_parallel.py` fails
deterministically on current main snapshot (`c1bb35f`), e.g. in #15846
(two runs, identical diff).

## Root cause
#15299 removed intermediate dtype casts for MoE top-k routing weights
(touched `vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/token_dispatcher.py` among others).
This deterministically shifts numerics on the **DP2+PP2** path of
DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat: greedy decoding now emits `I am a` (token `608`)
instead of `I'm a` (tokens `6, 76`). The TP2+PP2 path is unaffected and
still matches the existing golden.

#15299 updated the goldens it knew about (`test_graph_mode.py`), but its
CI run did not select `test_pipeline_parallel.py`, so this baseline was
missed.

## What this PR does
- introduce a separate `DP_GOLDEN` for the DP2+PP2 test case (prompt 0
updated to the new deterministic output, observed identically across
mp/ray backends and repeated runs)
- keep the shared `GOLDEN` untouched for TP2+PP2

## Notes
Prompt 1's DP2 output was not observable in the failure logs (the assert
fires on prompt 0 first), so its entry currently keeps the shared value;
if CI reports a drift there it can be updated in one line.
- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/ba07e4a48fc951300d97eb506217dd530583dea3

Signed-off-by: ZT-AIA <1028681969@qq.com>

commits.comment: 该 commit 修复 DeepSeek V4 在自定义执行路径上的权重格式兼容性问题。核心改动是在 AscendUnquantizedLinearMethod.process_weights_after_loading 中新增 per-layer 的 skip_weight_nz_conversion 标志读取，当层被标记时，跳过 weight_fp32 和常规权重的 ND->NZ 转换。标记位置包括：compressor 的 wkv/wgate（由自定义 compressor op 直接消费）和 DSA 的 wo_a（在 OTP 启用或 OLoRA TP 禁用时，使用 npu_transpose_batchmatmul 直接调用）。实现通过 getattr 读取标志，向后兼容默认 False，避免影响其他模型。潜在风险：wo_a 的标记条件依赖 oproj_tp_enable/olora_tp_enable 的运行时状态，如果这些配置在模型构建后变化可能导致格式不匹配；另外跳过 FP32 副本的 NZ 转换可能对特定路径的数值行为有影响，但这是有意的。测试方面新增了单测覆盖 per-layer 跳过和 FP32 copy 路径，但对 compressor 和 DSA 层中的标志设置没有直接断言，依赖模型级测试。整体改动范围小且针对性强，但涉及 DSV4 模型的量化/自定义 op 路径，需要设备端验证。

test_impact.reason: 虽然新增了线性层单测，但未覆盖 deepseek_v4 模型中 compressor 和 attention 层设置 skip_weight_nz_conversion 标志的逻辑；建议增加模型级或模块级测试，验证标志在 oproj_tp_enable/olora_tp_enable 各组合下是否正确设置，以及 FP32 权重副本的 ND 保持行为。

commits.message:
[BugFix] Keep unsupported DeepSeek V4 weights in ND format (#15834)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Keep DeepSeek V4 weights in ND format when they are consumed by
execution paths that bypass the regular Linear method:

- add a per-layer `skip_weight_nz_conversion` flag to unquantized Linear
weight post-processing;
- preserve ND for both the original weight and the optional FP32 copy;
- mark compressor `wkv` and `wgate` weights, which are passed directly
to the custom compressor op;
- mark DSA `wo_a` when OTP is enabled or OLoRA TP is disabled, because
those paths call `npu_transpose_batchmatmul` directly.

This is the `main`-branch counterpart of #15684. It is adapted to the
refactored DeepSeek V4 package layout and the hardware-profile-based
main branch. In particular, the DSA decision follows the active
execution path rather than hard-coding a device type; the A5 quantized
path uses a separate quantization method and is unaffected.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No API change. It fixes DeepSeek V4 runtime compatibility by preventing
unsupported ND-to-NZ weight conversion on custom execution paths.

### How was this patch tested?

- Added a unit test covering the per-layer bypass, including the FP32
weight-copy path.
- `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` on all changed Python files.
- Python `compileall` on all changed Python files.
- Project codespell, forbidden-import, boolean-context-manager, and
long-function checks on the changed files.
- Full device coverage is delegated to the vLLM Ascend PR CI matrix.

https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/ba07e4a48fc951300d97eb506217dd530583dea3
